{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert the 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders and LOYAL customers (using lowercase 'loyal')
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]

# Count the number of completed orders from LOYAL customers
n_orders = len(filtered_df)

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_df['revenue'].mean()

# Print both values
n_orders, mean_revenue"}
